# Glossary of Terms {.unnumbered}

This glossary defines the core contractual, cost-engineering, mechanical, liquid-cooling, electrical, fire-protection, automation, and commissioning terms used throughout this manual. Every entry summarizes both the technical engineering scope and its commercial demarcation or measurement significance for the MEP Quantity Surveyor, with links back to the primary chapters, tables, and equations where the topic is developed.
